note: Smoky Lake County campground on a treed peninsula on the east side of Hanmore Lake, about 20 km north of Smoky Lake, with a main beach, swim docks, boat launch and playground. Sites 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11 and 17 are the operator's 'Premium Waterfront' sites with their own shoreline; the rest are bush-side. Firewood, ice and kayak and paddleboard rentals on site. The nearest dump stations and showers are in Smoky Lake. --Claude
summary: Read the County page and Let's Camp: 16 sites + 1 group site, no services, C$25, May 14 - Oct 4, booked on Let's Camp (max 16 nights); all 16 single sites 25-75 ft, #10 pull-through. Waterfront not waterfront -> lakefront recommended (7 named waterfront sites 10-20 m from the water on open pads). Pin ~625 m off in the forest: move recommended.
